```sql
WITH lake_county_region AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Lake County' AND border_type = 'county'
),
parks_in_lake_county AS (
  SELECT park_name, geometry
  FROM parks
  WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM lake_county_region)::geometry)
),
largest_park AS (
  SELECT park_name, geometry
  FROM parks_in_lake_county
  ORDER BY ST_Area(geometry::geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT park_name FROM largest_park) AS park_name,
  MAX((ST_Value(r.rast, (SELECT geometry FROM largest_park)::geometry))::numeric) AS max_elevation
FROM public.dem_us r
WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geometry FROM largest_park)::geometry);
```
